A dried flower box is a charming and sustainable way to enjoy the beauty of flowers long after they've been picked. These boxes are carefully curated with an assortment of dried flowers, preserved to maintain their shape, color, and delicate beauty for an extended period.

Design and Composition

  • Variety of Flowers: Dried flower boxes typically include a variety of blooms such as roses, lavender, hydrangeas, and baby's breath. Each flower is selected for its ability to retain its natural color and shape even after drying.

  • Arrangement: Flowers are arranged artistically within the box, often complemented by decorative elements such as foliage, herbs, and grasses. This arrangement creates a visually appealing composition that showcases the textures and colors of each flower.

  • Box Material: The box itself is usually crafted from sustainable materials like recycled cardboard or natural wood, enhancing its eco-friendly appeal. It may be adorned with ribbons, labels, or personalized messages, adding a thoughtful touch.

Uses and Benefits

  • Decorative Accent: Dried flower boxes serve as versatile decorative accents, adding a touch of natural beauty to any space. They can be displayed on desks, shelves, or coffee tables, bringing a rustic charm and a sense of tranquility to the environment.

  • Longevity: Unlike fresh flowers that wilt quickly, dried flowers retain their appearance for months or even years with proper care. This makes dried flower boxes a lasting gift or home decor piece that continues to brighten spaces over time.

  • Sustainability: By using dried flowers, these boxes contribute to sustainable practices in floral arrangements. They reduce waste and minimize the environmental impact associated with traditional flower cultivation and disposal.

Occasions and Gifting

  • Gift Option: Dried flower boxes are popular as gifts for various occasions such as birthdays, anniversaries, Mother's Day, and housewarmings. They convey thoughtfulness and appreciation while offering a lasting reminder of the occasion.

  • Wedding Decor: They are also favored for weddings as centerpieces, aisle decorations, or guest favors. Dried flowers add a rustic elegance to wedding venues and can be cherished as keepsakes by guests.

Maintenance

  • Care Instructions: To maintain the beauty of dried flower boxes, they should be kept away from direct sunlight and humidity. Gentle dusting or occasional spritzing with floral preservatives can help retain their appearance and fragrance.

How to use art resin:

  1. Mix Resin and Hardener in the ratio 2:1 by volume preferably in paper/silicone cup with a wooden stirrer.
  2. Stir the mixture well for about 3 minutes. Let it sit for 1 minute for bubbles to release.
  3. Place the base on a levelled surface & pour the resin over your work.
  4. Bubbles if any, will start rising to the surface & will pop on their own. If not, use a hot air gun over the un-popped bubbles.
  5. The Resin needs to sit in a dust-free space while it cures. Within 24 to 48 hours fully cured (Curing time depends on weather conditions)
  • If required, apply 2nd coat only after the resin is fully cured.

These are the safest possible alcohol inks that are non-carcinogenic, uses plant based binders, and are ketone based making them non-irritating.

What are Alcohol Inks?

Alcohol inks are highly saturated permanent inks that dry out super quickly and create beautiful patterns. These come in a pack of 3 bottles and a total of 18 colors. Use the colors individually or mix them to create beautiful new shades.

What substrates work with Alcohol Inks?

Alcohol inks can be used on any non-porous surface. They work the best on our YUPO paper or on any non-porous surfaces like ceramics, plastics, glass, metal etc. 

How do you clean up?

Alcohol inks can be cleaned up with our Blending Solution or Iso Propyl Alcohol. To dilute the inks, reduce the intensity of the color or increase the fluidity and work time use blending solution with the inks.

What can you create with these inks?

Create beautiful abstracts, upcycle your boring planters into something interesting, create decorative ceramics, create resin petris and many more! 

Note: Always seal your artwork with a spray varnish/mod-podge/resin to keep them protected for a very long time.

Long Description:
EPOKE SIL Mould Making Silicone when used as instructed is tear-resistant and has zero shrinkage. Moulds made with EPOKE SIL will last a long time in your mould library and are good for casting wax, gypsum, resins, concrete and other materials. 

Mixing Ratio : 1:1 by weight Eg: 10g Part A + 10g Part B

Pot Life : 30min @25 Degree Celsius

Cure time : 4-5Hours  @25 Degree Celsius

Temperature Resistance: Up to 200 Degree Celsius

Instructions for use :

Measuring :

Using a weighing scale measure Part A and Part B in a 1:1 ratio by weight (eg. 10g of Part A and 10g of Part B ) into a mixing container.

Mixing: 

Mix slowly and thoroughly making sure that you scrape the sides and bottom of the mixing container several times. Mix until mixture has attained a uniform colour without any unmixed streaks of material.  

Pouring :

 For best results, pour your mixture in a single spot at the lowest point of the mould container. A uniform flow will help minimise entrapped air.  EPOKE SIL should level off at least 1/2” (1.3 cm) over the highest point of the model surface.

Curing 

 Allow EPOKE SIL silicone rubber to cure for 4-5 hours at room temperature (25°C) before de-moulding.

Mould Performance & Storage 

 The physical life of the mould depends on how you use it (materials cast, frequency, etc.). Casting abrasive materials can quickly erode the mould detail while casting non-abrasive materials (wax) will not affect mould detail. Moulds should be stored on a level surface in a cool, dry environment.

 

( Safety - Use in a properly ventilated area. Wear safety glasses and gloves while using EPOKE SIL.  Store and use the material at room temperature (25°C). Warmer temperatures will drastically reduce working time and cure time. Storing material at warmer temperatures will also reduce the usable shelf life of unused material. These products have a limited shelf life of 6 months and should be used as soon as possible. Keep out of reach of children. DO NOT CONSUME)

Can also be used to rejuvenate worn out and scratched resin surfaces.

Directions for use:

1. Wearing gloves, smear on a very thin layer of Epoke Pop Polish onto your resin surface.

2. You may run a foam-padded polish gun or just use a block of foam and rub the resined surface. With a gun, bear in mind that you will have to move the gun across the surface quickly and gently. Ensure the gun isn’t stationary over any spot for more than 3 seconds.

3. After 15 minutes, wipe the surface down with a clean and dry microfibre cloth.

4. Enjoy the smooth, glossy, scratch-resistant finish.

Long Description:
Camel Artist Gesso is a widely used primer in the art community, essential for preparing surfaces before painting. Here’s an overview of the Camel Artist Gesso 100ml:

 

Features:

High-Quality Primer: Camel Artist Gesso is formulated to provide a smooth, even surface that enhances paint adhesion. It creates an excellent base for acrylics, oils, and other painting media.

Versatile Application: Suitable for use on various surfaces including canvas, wood, paper, and even fabric. It prepares these surfaces to accept paint more effectively, preventing the paint from soaking in and ensuring vibrant, true colors.

Easy to Use: The gesso can be applied with a brush or roller. It dries quickly, allowing artists to begin painting sooner. Multiple coats can be applied for a thicker, more textured surface.

Consistency and Coverage: Camel Artist Gesso offers a balanced consistency that spreads easily and covers well. One or two coats are usually sufficient to prepare the surface adequately.

Size and Portability: The 100ml size is convenient for both studio use and for artists on the go. It’s enough to prepare several small to medium-sized canvases.

 

Ideal For:

  • Artists of All Levels: Whether you’re a beginner or a professional, gesso is a fundamental tool in preparing your painting surfaces.
  • Mixed Media Artists: Those who work with various materials and surfaces will find this gesso versatile and reliable.

Benefits:

  • Improved Adhesion: Ensures that paint adheres well to the surface, reducing the risk of peeling or flaking.
  • Enhanced Paint Quality: Helps in achieving more vibrant colors and smoother brush strokes.
  • Surface Protection: Acts as a protective layer for the substrate, extending the longevity of your artwork.

 

Tips for Using Camel Artist Gesso:

Preparation: Ensure the surface is clean and free of dust and grease before applying gesso.

Application: Use a wide, flat brush or roller for even application. Start with a thin coat and let it dry completely before applying additional coats if needed.

Sanding: For an ultra-smooth surface, lightly sand the gesso once it’s dry and apply a second coat.

Customizing: You can tint gesso with acrylic paint to create a colored primer.

 

Frequently Asked Questions:

 

How long does Camel Artist Gesso take to dry?

    • Answer: It typically dries to the touch within 30 minutes to an hour, depending on the thickness of the application and environmental conditions. However, it’s recommended to wait 24 hours before painting over it for best results.

 

Can I use this gesso on surfaces other than canvas?

    • Answer: Yes, Camel Artist Gesso is versatile and can be used on wood, paper, fabric, and other surfaces to prepare them for painting.

 

Do I need to sand the surface before applying gesso?

    • Answer: It’s not always necessary, but lightly sanding the surface can help improve adhesion, especially on smoother surfaces like wood or pre-primed canvases.

 

How many coats of gesso should I apply?

    • Answer: Typically, one or two coats are sufficient. However, for a thicker and more textured surface, additional coats can be applied as needed.

Mochiri Kiyome Pen Cleansing Solution(45ML)

Refined care for the pens you value most.

A fine fountain pen deserves more than careful writing — it deserves careful maintenance too.

Mochiri Kiyome Pen Cleansing Solution is thoughtfully created to help keep your fountain pens clean, fresh, and performing smoothly. Designed for nib, feed, and converter care, Kiyome helps remove ink residue and supports a cleaner writing experience, especially during ink changes or after long periods of use.

Whether you own a daily writer or a treasured collectible, Kiyome brings a premium pen-care ritual to your desk.

Why You’ll Love It

  • Designed for fountain pen nib, feed, and converter cleaning
  • Helps clear ink buildup and residue
  • Ideal while changing ink colours
  • Useful for pens with dry flow or inconsistent writing
  • A refined pen-care essential for collectors and enthusiasts
  • Presented in a premium bottle to complement luxury stationery setups

What It’s Best For

Mochiri Kiyome is ideal for:

  • Routine fountain pen maintenance
  • Removing leftover ink from nib and feed
  • Cleaning before switching to a new ink colour
  • Restoring a cleaner flow in frequently used pens
  • Preparing pens before storage

Directions to Use

  1. Remove the cartridge or converter from the pen.
  2. Rinse the nib section gently with clean water.
  3. Add a few drops of Mochiri Kiyome into a small cup of water.
  4. Soak the nib section for 5–10 minutes.
  5. Flush the pen gently until the water runs clear.
  6. Rinse once again with clean water.
  7. Wipe with a soft cloth and allow the pen to air-dry fully before refilling.

Recommended Usage

Use once every 2–4 weeks, or whenever:

  • changing ink colours
  • experiencing dry or reduced flow
  • cleaning a pen after prolonged use
  • storing a pen for an extended period

Long Description:
Mochiri Kiyome Pen Cleansing Solution

Refined care for the pens you value most.

A fine fountain pen deserves more than careful writing — it deserves careful maintenance too.

Mochiri Kiyome Pen Cleansing Solution is thoughtfully created to help keep your fountain pens clean, fresh, and performing smoothly. Designed for nib, feed, and converter care, Kiyome helps remove ink residue and supports a cleaner writing experience, especially during ink changes or after long periods of use.

Whether you own a daily writer or a treasured collectible, Kiyome brings a premium pen-care ritual to your desk.

Why You’ll Love It

  • Designed for fountain pen nib, feed, and converter cleaning
  • Helps clear ink buildup and residue
  • Ideal while changing ink colours
  • Useful for pens with dry flow or inconsistent writing
  • A refined pen-care essential for collectors and enthusiasts
  • Presented in a premium bottle to complement luxury stationery setups

What It’s Best For

Mochiri Kiyome is ideal for:

  • Routine fountain pen maintenance
  • Removing leftover ink from nib and feed
  • Cleaning before switching to a new ink colour
  • Restoring a cleaner flow in frequently used pens
  • Preparing pens before storage

Directions to Use

  1. Remove the cartridge or converter from the pen.
  2. Rinse the nib section gently with clean water.
  3. Add a few drops of Mochiri Kiyome into a small cup of water.
  4. Soak the nib section for 5–10 minutes.
  5. Flush the pen gently until the water runs clear.
  6. Rinse once again with clean water.
  7. Wipe with a soft cloth and allow the pen to air-dry fully before refilling.

Recommended Usage

Use once every 2–4 weeks, or whenever:

  • changing ink colours
  • experiencing dry or reduced flow
  • cleaning a pen after prolonged use
  • storing a pen for an extended period

A clear rubber stamp is a type of stamp used in arts and crafts that is made of a clear polymer material instead of traditional rubber. Clear stamps are transparent and typically come on a backing sheet that allows the stamper to see exactly where they are placing the stamp on their project.

Clear rubber stamps are popular among crafters and artists because they are versatile, easy to use, and provide precise, detailed impressions. They can be used with a variety of inks and markers and can be cleaned easily with a damp cloth or stamp cleaner.

Clear rubber stamps are often sold individually or in sets and can be used to create custom designs, decorate cards, scrapbooks, and other paper crafts. They are available in various themes and styles, from floral and nature designs to sentiments and quotes.

Typically, a set of 24 sketching pencils would include various grades of hardness, allowing you to create a range of light and dark values in your sketches. Here's a breakdown of what you might expect to find in such a set:

  1. HB: This is a medium hardness pencil and is a good all-around choice for general sketching.

  2. B-series: These pencils have softer leads and are suitable for creating darker lines and shading. The B-series typically includes pencils like 2B, 3B, 4B, 5B, 6B, 7B, and 8B. The higher the number, the softer and darker the pencil.

  3. H-series: These pencils have harder leads and are suitable for creating lighter lines and finer details. The H-series typically includes pencils like 2H, 3H, 4H, 5H, 6H, 7H, and 8H. The higher the number, the harder and lighter the pencil.

  4. F: This is a fine point pencil, which provides a sharp and precise line for detailed work.

  5. Other grades: In addition to the common B, H, and HB pencils, some sets may include extra grades such as 9B, 9H, or even extra-fine point pencils like 0.5mm or 0.7mm.

Having a set of 24 sketching pencils gives you a lot of flexibility to experiment with different hardness levels and create a wide range of effects in your sketches. It's always helpful to test the pencils on a separate sheet of paper to familiarize yourself with their characteristics before starting your artwork.
